title: Keyword(pub String) exposes internals, breaks future validation
description: Keyword(pub String) — the inner String is pub. Any caller can construct Keyword("".to_owned()) or Keyword("invalid!keyword".to_owned()) bypassing any validation. If we ever want to add syntax validation (RFC 8621 §4.1.1 keywords must match atom syntax), making the field private is a breaking change. The new(), From<&str>, and From<String> impls already provide a clean construction surface; the pub inner field adds nothing. Fix: make inner field private (Keyword(String)), keep existing trait impls.
